glosses: To shift chaotically; to splash noisily.

examples.text: The water in his bottle sloshed back and forth as he ran.
The boy sloshed water over the edge of the bath.
His boots were so completely soaked that they sloshed when he walked.

glosses: To pour noisily, sloppily or in large amounts.

examples.text: The coffee was nice and hot, so she sloshed some into a cup and went back to her desk.
He really sloshed on the sauce- they were a bit strong for my taste.

glosses: to move noisily through water or other liquid.

examples.text: The streets were flooded, but they still managed to slosh their way to school.
